articles.title: Violet Membrane
articles.summary: Purple-black foam cells with bright walls and a glowing dot in each, semi-matte with heavy sparkle. A dark royal purple-black with big shard-shaped panels and bright violet-blue edge highlights; reads as moody, glassy and dark.
articles.what: Foam pack with bright walls and a nucleus dot set in every cell. FRACTURED PETRI. Up close: Deep indigo and near-black cells 100 to 300 px wide with curved pointed edges, like a taut stretched membrane, wing veins or crazed glass. Each cell has fine brushed streaks pulling toward its corners; borders are lined with thin lilac and speckled seams, with cyan and pink glints at the. From a distance: A dark royal purple-black with big shard-shaped panels and bright violet-blue edge highlights; reads as moody, glassy and dark. Measured spec (average): metal 126, roughness 124, coat 127. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: medium. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, hero panel, sides.
Fits: gt / sports car, show car, open wheel.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Violet Membrane" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood and sides: big cells need space to show
Roof works too; trim shows partial cells
White or yellow numbers read; dark ones vanish, and cell edges cross thin strokes.
Almost nothing: the cell structure is the pattern
Pairs well with: black, chrome, magenta, silver.
pitfalls: Not foam with a dot in every cell: the old card says glowing nucleus dots, the render shows large streaked shard cells with no central dots
Not bubble wrap: cells are big angular curved shapes, not rounded bubbles
Avoid: busy under numbers, large dark areas in sim.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 126 (pearl-level metal), roughness 124 (satin or eggshell), clearcoat 127 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: busy under numbers, large dark areas in sim.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: the cell structure is the pattern; a thin silver or chrome pinline
Patterns to avoid: cell, crack or glass patterns: duplicate the structure; flake: buries the delicate seams
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat spec on the dark faces for contrast; fine pearl spec: enhances the violet-cyan sheen
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

examples.title: Put it on a zone

examples.result: The finish shows its own colours and spec together.
